params.name: is_featured
params.description: Omit for all templates. When set, filter by featured flag; parsed with str_to_bool (same as other API query booleans).

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

params.name: ordering
params.description: Optional. When not using `search`, results are sorted with featured templates first (`is_featured=true`), then by `template_name` (case-insensitive A–Z; `-template_name` for Z–A) or by `created_at` (`-created_at` for newest first). When `search` is set, order is featured first, then relevance rank, then case-insensitive name for ties.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.

params.name: scope
params.description: Optional. `global`: official templates only. `team`: this project's saved templates only (`scope=team` rows for the current project). `feature_flag`: feature-flag dashboard templates only. Omit for both official and this project's templates (default dashboard template picker behavior).

info.name: Copy a team template to this project

params.name: project_id
params.description: Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.

items.docs: Creates a new team-scoped template in the **target** project (URL) from a **team-scoped** source template in the same organization. Global and feature-flag templates return 400. Cross-organization or inaccessible sources return 404. Source and destination projects must differ (400 if equal). Conflicting `template_name` values on the destination are auto-suffixed with `(copy)`, `(copy 2)`, …
